! BEGIN CONTROLLERS

  role active

description primaryexitcontroller controller-b
  management-ip 10.0.0.11
  cluster-name cluster-a
  role standby
ha-peer controller-a  site site-a
exit! END CONTROLLERS
! BEGIN SWITCHES
switch leaf-1
  management-ip 10.0.0.1
  role filter
  site site-a
model 7050exitswitch leaf-2

  role delivery
  site site-a
exit! END SWITCHES
! BEGIN INTERFACES

  role filter

exitinterface leaf-2 ethernet2
  role delivery

exit! END INTERFACES
! BEGIN GROUPS

exit! END GROUPS
